INDIAN PHARMACOPOEIA COMMISSION

MIN. OF HEALTH & FAMILY WELFARE
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA
SEC.-23, RAJ NAGAR, GHAZIABAD -201 002.

No.IPC/IPL/AR&D/7020/IP New Monographs Dated: Dec. 10, 2014.

To,

  1. Drugs Controller General (India)
  2. All Zonal Offices/Port Offices CDSCO/Sea Port
  3. All State Drug Controllers,
  4. Director of all Central Drugs Laboratories
  5. Government Analysts
  6. Director of all States Drug Laboratories,
  7. IDMA/OPPI/BDMA/FFSAI/Small Scale Industry Associations

NOTICE

As per the decision taken in the 29th Scientific Body meeting of IPC, the Secretariat of IPC has agreed to give relaxation of another three months i.e. upto 31st March, 2015 to implement the changes prescribed in IP Addendum 2015.

Yours faithfully,

(Dr. G. N. Singh)

Secretary-cum-Scientific Director

Copy to:

(i) PPS to Secretary (H&FW), Ministry of Health Family Welfare, Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi.

(ii) PS to Additional Secretary & DG (CGHS), Ministry of Health Family Welfare, Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi.

(iii) PS to Joint Secretary (R), Ministry of Health Family Welfare, Nirman Bhawan, New Delhi.
